name: Past, Present, Future
summary: The classic three-card linear progression mapping temporal development and trajectory.
author: Traditional

instructions.preparation: Ground your focus on the situation at hand and recognize time as a fluid narrative continuum.
instructions.shuffle: Thoroughly riffle or overhand shuffle while contemplating how prior choices led to this moment.
instructions.drawing: Deal three cards from left to right: Slot 1 (Past), Slot 2 (Present), Slot 3 (Future).
instructions.synthesis: Observe the progression from left to right. Are suits transitioning? Does the energy accelerate, ground, or resolve?
